verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents a scoped 'widget key' with a single signal:write scope (foreloop-docs-12) and separately notes that agents can use the CLI/MCP and a FORELOOP_TOKEN to read/update Foreloop (foreloop-docs-28, foreloop-docs-17), showing the product has a scoping concept and agent-facing tokens, but never ties the two together into an explicit least-privilege credential issued specifically for agents. Missing for 10: documented scopes/permissions for the FORELOOP_TOKEN or MCP credentials, ability to restrict an agent's token to specific actions, and independent confirmation of this working.
